name: cybersecurity-portfolio
description: 3D Interactive Cybersecurity Portfolio & SOC Threat Detection Station for Muhammed Sinan

scripts.dev: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=path.join('.',req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.split('?')[0]);if(!fs.existsSync(f)){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not Found');return;}const ext=path.extname(f);const m={'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'application/javascript','.json':'application/json','.svg':'image/svg+xml'}[ext]||'application/octet-stream';res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m});fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res);}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('🛸 Cyber Command Station running at http://localhost:8080'));"
scripts.build: node --check js/sound-fx.js js/three-scene.js js/skills-3d.js js/terminal.js js/main.js && node -e "console.log('✓ [BUILD SUCCESSFUL] 3D WebGL scenes, Cyber scripts, and HTML structure verified.');"
scripts.test: node --check js/sound-fx.js js/three-scene.js js/skills-3d.js js/terminal.js js/main.js

author: Muhammed Sinan
